fusions.name: Bang and Gone
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Parting Blast
fusions.desc: Fires a blast 3 tiles ahead that deals 14 damage to everything in it and knocks each back 3 tiles. For 3 seconds after firing, you move 30% faster.

fusions.name: Sight Line
fusions.desc: Increases your critical chance by 25% for 12 seconds and slips you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Quick Reload
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 4 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
